$description: Illustration (platform/components/Illustration, library wave 3): the sizes, the line widths and the color role of every part of a drawing. Theme roles only: the set has no colors of its own.

illustration-sm-size.$description: Illustration: the spot size (sm), beside a short message.

illustration-md-size.$description: Illustration: the scene size (md, the default), in an empty state.

illustration-lg-size.$description: Illustration: the large scene (lg), a full-page empty or error state.

illustration-stroke-width.$description: Illustration: the width of every line at md and lg (kept at every size: non-scaling).

illustration-sm-stroke-width.$description: Illustration: the width of every line at the spot size (sm).

illustration-back.$description: Illustration: the round backdrop behind a drawing.

illustration-shape.$description: Illustration: the fill of the drawn objects (a folder, a page, a window).

illustration-line.$description: Illustration: the outlines and lines of the drawn objects.

illustration-ghost.$description: Illustration: placeholder shapes (the bars of an empty chart): the skeleton color.

illustration-accent.$description: Illustration: the one accent of a drawing: the brand blue (the brand mark’s token).

illustration-knock.$description: Illustration: a line drawn on the accent (a check, a plus).

illustration-danger.$description: Illustration: the accent of an error drawing: the danger color.

illustration-danger-knock.$description: Illustration: a line drawn on the danger accent (an exclamation mark).

illustration-on-accent-back.$description: Illustration: the backdrop on the accent surface.

illustration-on-accent-shape.$description: Illustration: the drawn objects on the accent surface.

illustration-on-accent-line.$description: Illustration: the lines on the accent surface.

illustration-on-accent-ghost.$description: Illustration: placeholder shapes on the accent surface.

illustration-on-accent-accent.$description: Illustration: the accent (and the danger accent) on the accent surface.

illustration-on-accent-knock.$description: Illustration: a line drawn on the accent, on the accent surface.
